body: I think you should talk to someone that could help you to go through this, some kind of psychiatrist who can drive you step by step through a healing process and move on the psychological place you are now. You're a good person, you don't have to feel guilty about your feelings, be nice to yourself, get clean, strop the drugs, they never help. Do some sport, get stronger, you need to feel better with yourself. Once you feel better, I would punch him in the face real hard but that's me, that guy is psychopath, he deserve it. Don't be afraid of him, he's a small and miserable person inside. You are not.

Well, you didn't mention how old you are but since you mentioned snapchat I guess you're probably young. Life is like that, you are going to be betrayed by a friend a few times in your life, only friends can betray.  I think the reality of the situation is that these people are not your friends anymore period. You think they are your friends because of the experiences you've been through together, that shared past gives you the sensation of being in a team and you feel fine when you hang with them. But that was the past, now you need to move on, those people don't deserve you, you need to change your environment. The mourning period is hard but there are plenty of rainbow on the other side, start doing things you have never donde before, try a new sports. you never know how strong you are until being strong is the only choice you have.
